_comment: Template: SPARQL SELECT query against one or more RDF model files.
_how_to_use: Copy to your working directory. Replace REPLACE_WITH_PATH values. Run: java -jar CimPal-CLI.jar sparql --config this-file.json
_when_to_use: Use this to inspect model data directly — list instances of a class, check property values, count triples by type, or debug why a SHACL constraint did or did not fire.
_note_models: One or more model files to load. All are merged into a single RDF graph before the query runs, so you can query across multiple instance files at once. Accepts .xml, .rdf, .ttl, or .zip containing RDF/XML. Example: ['C:/Data/EQ.xml', 'C:/Data/TP.xml', 'C:/Data/SV.xml'] — loads all three and queries them as one combined graph.
_note_query: Either: a path to a .sparql or .rq file containing the SPARQL SELECT query (recommended — keeps the query version-controlled). Or: an inline SPARQL string like 'SELECT ?s ?p ?o WHERE { ?s ?p ?o } LIMIT 20'. The CLI checks if the value is a file path first; if the file exists, it reads it; otherwise it treats the value as an inline query.
_note_xmlBase: Base URI for parsing the model files. Must match the namespace in the XML. Same values as the validate command: http://iec.ch/TC57/CIM100 for CIM17, http://iec.ch/TC57/2013/CIM-schema-cim16 for CIM16.
_note_output: Where to write the query results. Use .xlsx extension for an Excel workbook (one sheet, header row 1). Any other extension writes a CSV file. If omitted, results are printed to stdout in the format specified by the 'format' field below. Inline: use --output flag to set the output file.
_note_format_option: The 'format' field is not in this config because output is set above, but you can add it. Valid values: 'text' (pipe-separated table to stdout), 'json' (JSON object to stdout), 'csv' (CSV to stdout). Only applies when 'output' is not set.

_example_useful_queries.list_all_classes: SELECT DISTINCT ?type (COUNT(?s) AS ?count) WHERE { ?s a ?type } GROUP BY ?type ORDER BY DESC(?count)
_example_useful_queries.find_by_class: SELECT ?s ?name WHERE { ?s a cim:ACLineSegment . OPTIONAL { ?s cim:IdentifiedObject.name ?name } } LIMIT 100
_example_useful_queries.find_missing_required: SELECT ?s WHERE { ?s a cim:ACLineSegment . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?s cim:ConductingEquipment.BaseVoltage ?bv } } LIMIT 20
